description: This file contains unit tests for the CameraHandler component, specifically testing the behavior of the function isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit and verifying the constant CAMERA_CLIP_MAX_RAW_BYTES.

classes.name: CameraHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CameraHandler functions and constants.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_allowsZeroAndLimit
methods.description: Tests that the function returns true for zero and maximum allowed payload size.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit_rejectsNegativeAndTooLarge
methods.description: Tests that the function returns false for negative values and values exceeding the maximum limit.

methods.name: cameraClipMaxRawBytes_matchesExpectedBudget
methods.description: Verifies that the CAMERA_CLIP_MAX_RAW_BYTES constant matches the expected byte size.
